Mission Local reported that, after a two-and-a-half-year process, the State Bar sent DA Brooke Jenkins to a diversionary program to resolve ethics complaints. The story says the Bar set aside the complaints except for one involving Jenkins’s access to and sharing of a confidential rap sheet. The program was described by the Bar as appropriate for cases of isolated misconduct with a low risk to public protection.
